history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: the CSV name 'Durga Mata Mandir' is generic and no dedicated web source documents a shrine of exactly that name in Barnala town. The best-supported candidate is the 'Durga Mandir Prachin Shri Durga Mandir' listed at Handiaya, Barnala (a Justdial temples-in-Barnala listing, rated 4.4 with 24 reviews), documented here provisionally. CORRECTION: the actual location is Handiaya, a town in Barnala district about 10 km from Barnala - not Barnala town itself. The National Mission on Monuments and Antiquities lists an unnamed colonial-era (1919) built-heritage temple site at Barnala Rural (ref PB16017606), but its name and deity are not recorded there, so no link to this shrine can be established. No reliable history, founding date, or verified image could be found; identity should be re-verified against the CSV compiler's intended referent. Coordinates are the town coordinates of Handiaya (approximate).

name: Durga Mata Mandir
town_description: Handiaya (also spelled Handiya) is a small town in Barnala district, Punjab, about 10 km from Barnala town, on the road network linking Barnala with Sangrur. Handiaya itself hosts the notable Durga Mandir recorded here, along with a Khatu Shyam Mandir and a Shiv Math.

travel.airport: Chandigarh International Airport, about 145 km away (verify).
travel.railway: Barnala Junction is the nearest major station, about 10 km away.
travel.road: Reached by road from Barnala town (about 10 km) on local roads toward Sangrur.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri for festive visits.
